environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as a Docker container with default configuration. Container runs as root. The Flask app is exposed via an nginx reverse proxy on port 443 with TLS termination. No additional security layers between the client and the application. Docker container uses default seccomp profile. The instance has IAM role with S3 and SSM access for operational purposes.

config.network: nginx reverse proxy -> Flask app on port 8080
config.os: Amazon Linux 2 host, default Docker seccomp
